verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Gemini in BigQuery generates or suggests SQL and Python code, explains existing SQL queries, and lets users find, join and query table assets in natural language inside the product. Conversational analytics and data insights add schema- and metadata-aware query generation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-driven SQL error fixing (only implied by 'suggest'/'complete'), and independent hands-on corroboration of the assistant's quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a built-in AI assistant writes, fixes, and explains SQL against my schemas from natural language, inside the product

citations.quote: BigQuery의 Gemini를 사용하여 SQL 또는 Python에서 코드를 생성하거나 제안하고 기존 SQL 쿼리를 설명할 수 있습니다.
BigQuery의 Gemini로 자연어를 사용하여 테이블 애셋을 찾고 조인하고 쿼리하고 결과를 시각화하며
您还可以使用自然语言查询来开始数据分析。如需了解如何生成、补全和总结代码
